parameters.help_en:
The configurations of the trigger. The configurations vary based on the trigger type. The following items list the data structures for different types of triggers:

OSS triggers: https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2766465.html.
Simple Log Service trigger: https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2618711.html.
Time triggers: https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2754638.html.
HTTP triggers: https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2766461.html.
Tablestore triggers: Specify the SourceArnm parameter and leave this parameter empty.
Alibaba Cloud CDN event triggers: https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2766462.html.
MNS topic triggers: https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2766464.html.
EventBridge-based triggers: https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2766447.html
parameters.help_zh:
触发器配置，针对不同类型的触发器，配置有所不同。具体格式请参见如下对应的数据结构：
OSS触发器：请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2766465.html。
日志服务触发器：请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2766469.html。
定时触发器：请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2754638.html。
HTTP触发器：请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2766461.html。
Tablestore触发器：只需要填写完整的SourceArn参数便可, 这里无需额外配置，取值为空{}。
CDN事件触发器：请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2766462.html。
MNS主题触发器：请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2766464.html。
EventBridge触发器：请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2766447.html
parameters.name: trigger_config

parameters.help_en:
The type of the trigger. Valid values:

oss: OSS event triggers. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2513613.html.
log: Simple Log Service triggers. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2513638.html.
timer: time triggers. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2513611.html.
http: HTTP triggers. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2513634.html.
tablestore: Tablestore triggers. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2513640.html.
cdn_events: CDN event triggers. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2513636.html.
mns_topic: Message Service (MNS) topic triggers. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2513641.html.
eventbridge: EventBridge-based triggers
